message.mountain_breathes.knocked_down: He comes down on his belly.
message.mountain_breathes.phase1: He stops, and something changes in him. Half of him is gone and he knows it.
message.mountain_breathes.phase2: He is falling apart and he does not care any more.
message.mountain_breathes.weakspot: His heart is showing. Hit it.
message.mountain_breathes.struggle_hint: His fingers are closing. Hammer JUMP to tear free!
message.mountain_breathes.broke_free: You rip an arm loose and drop out of his hand!

message.mountain_breathes.horn_empty: The horn sounds, and nothing answers.

message.mountain_breathes.compass_none: Nothing answers. There is none of him in the world yet.
message.mountain_breathes.compass_wait: The last one is dead. Another gets up in about %s days.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_none: The book is quiet. There is none of him within reach.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_come: He turns and starts walking. %s blocks away.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_goto: He is on his way to %s, %s.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_free: He is free to wander again.
message.mountain_breathes.riding: You are on his head. He goes where you look; crouch to get off.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_only_one: The pages rot in your hands. There is only one of this book.
codex.mountain_breathes.burrow: Go under to where I look
codex.mountain_breathes.far: Nothing answers. He is too far away to hear the book.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_nowhere: Nothing that way to walk to.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_cannot_r: He won't come for you right now.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_cannot_b: He can't go under right now.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_under: He folds into the ground, bound for %s, %s.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_calloff: He forgets it and stands easy.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_cooling: He needs another %s seconds before that one.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_cannot_a: He can't do that right now.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_break_on: He wrecks what he walks over again.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_breathe: He draws in a long breath.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_cough: He coughs up everything inside him.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_forgive: He forgets everyone who has hurt him.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_spared: He will leave %s alone while you have the book.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_no_playe: Look at a player or a creature.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_wait: The last one is dead. Another gets up in about %s days.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_nowhere_: Nothing answers. There is none of him in the world yet.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_under_wa: He has only just come up. He won't dig in again for about %s days.
message.mountain_breathes.inside_him: He has you. You work him from up here.
inside.mountain_breathes.title: YOU ARE THE MOUNTAIN

message.mountain_breathes.thrown_out: Something got a hit in on you. He drops you, and he won't have you back for a while.
message.mountain_breathes.shut_out: He will not have you. Try again in about %s minutes.
message.mountain_breathes.coming_for_you: He is coming for you. %s blocks off.
message.mountain_breathes.lost_you: He gave up looking for you.
message.mountain_breathes.list_off: The book has left you. Your safe list means nothing until you have it back.
message.mountain_breathes.setting_down: A hand takes you out of the seat and carries you down.
message.mountain_breathes.set_down: He sets you on the ground.
message.mountain_breathes.reaching_down: He stands over you and a hand comes down.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_spared_k: He will leave %s alone while you have the book.
message.mountain_breathes.on_his_way: He is on his way. %s blocks off.
message.mountain_breathes.compass_walkin: He is walking to %s, %s. About %s minutes out.
message.mountain_breathes.compass_doing: He is loaded and %s right now.
message.mountain_breathes.compass_last: That is where he was last seen; nothing is running him out there.
message.mountain_breathes.heart_roar: The heart answers in his voice. Everything around it runs.
message.mountain_breathes.heart_spent: It is dark and still. %ss before it answers you again.
codex.mountain_breathes.hunted: He is hunting you. %s days of it left.
mood.mountain_breathes.2: · he is ignoring half of it
mood.mountain_breathes.3: · he does as he likes now
mood.mountain_breathes.4: · he is done listening to you
message.mountain_breathes.codex_winded: Nothing. He has no wind left in him.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_slow: He hears you. He takes his time about it.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_ignored: He looks at you and does nothing.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_turned: The page means nothing to him now.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_own_targ: He hears you, and goes after what he likes instead.
message.mountain_breathes.book_burnt: The book goes up in your hands.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_not_your: That is the whole world's to set, not yours.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_far_come: He is %s blocks out. He turns and starts walking to you — about %s minutes.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_far_goto: He turns for %s, %s out there. About %s minutes of walking.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_far_unde: He goes under where he stands and runs for %s, %s. About %s minutes.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_far_stop: He stops where he is, %s blocks out.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_far_no: He is %s blocks away and out of the world. Only where he walks can be changed from here.
codex.mountain_breathes.end_last: He does not get up from this, and neither does your name.
codex.mountain_breathes.end_warn1: You can only ask this of him with a quarter of him left. It kills him.
codex.mountain_breathes.end_warn2: Twenty seconds of it. The sky goes over and every eye he has left burns.
codex.mountain_breathes.end_warn3: Then the ground goes for four hundred blocks, and a wave a thousand more.
codex.mountain_breathes.end_warn4: Everything alive near him dies. His heart is left in the middle of it.
codex.mountain_breathes.end_warn5: No book will ever stay in your hands again. It burns when you touch one.
codex.mountain_breathes.end_warn6: Every Mountain there will ever be knows you. No list covers you. For good.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_end_off: That page has been torn out of the book.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_end_whol: There is far too much of him left. He is at %s%%, and he will not be asked this above a quarter.
message.mountain_breathes.unmake_coming: Somewhere a long way off, something enormous is standing all the way up.
message.mountain_breathes.unmake_done: The ground is gone for %s blocks across, and he went with it.
message.mountain_breathes.unmake_marked: He knew who asked. They all know now. No book will stay in your hands again.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_will_not: It goes up the second it touches you. It always will.
codex.mountain_breathes.end_warn7: Kill him the ordinary way and none of this happens. Only asking marks you.
message.mountain_breathes.lets_it_go: He lets it go. %s more and he won't.
message.mountain_breathes.had_enough: That was one too many. The book in your hands means nothing to him now.
message.mountain_breathes.codex_crumbles: It comes apart in your hands. There is only ever one, and this was not it.
message.mountain_breathes.down_for_good: Something goes out of him. He comes down on his belly and he does not get up. He is still looking at you.
message.mountain_breathes.ward_on: The heart goes off like a drum. He will not come within %s blocks of here for %s.
message.mountain_breathes.ward_off: The heart goes quiet. Whatever was keeping him off is not keeping him off any more.
message.mountain_breathes.ward_running: It is beating. He is being held off for another %s.
message.mountain_breathes.ward_elsewhere: Another one of these is already beating somewhere. %s left on it.
message.mountain_breathes.ward_dark: It is cold. It has to gather itself for another %s.
message.mountain_breathes.ward_broken: The heart is pulled out of the ground and stops. He can come back.
message.mountain_breathes.ward_refused: He will not go there. His own heart is beating in that place.
message.mountain_breathes.crippled_refus: He has no legs left to do that on.
message.mountain_breathes.scars_cleared: Every mark of every fight is taken off him.
item.mountain_breathes.mountain_heart.ti: Set it down and knock on it.
Holds him %s blocks off for %s minutes.
message.mountain_breathes.crater_going: The ground is still going. %s%% of the hole is open.
message.mountain_breathes.crater_done: The ground stops falling. The hole is %s blocks across.
message.mountain_breathes.made_way: He comes apart where he stands. Something newer is out there wearing him.
message.mountain_breathes.shadow_up: Something comes up out of the ground behind you wearing your shape. It stands while he can see you.
message.mountain_breathes.shadow_gone: Out of his sight, it falls apart.
message.mountain_breathes.draw_in: He breathes in and does not stop. Get something solid between you and his head.
message.mountain_breathes.tear_off: He puts a hand into his own side and pulls. What comes out stands up.
codex.mountain_breathes.takes_it_badly: He holds this one against you
